title: Multi-Currency Ledger Rounding & Credit Split
prompt:
Fix the accounting and rounding bugs in this multi-currency ledger library.

Reported issues:
1. Splitting amounts (`splitByWeights`) loses or misallocates remainder minor units, and negative credit-note splits can corrupt signs or fail to sum back to the exact input total.
2. Zero-decimal currencies (`JPY`, `KRW`, `VND`) and three-decimal currencies (`BHD`, `KWD`, `OMR`) are incorrectly scaled as 2-decimal currencies.
3. Tax calculation and invoice line/discount/tax math suffer from floating-point drift and asymmetric rounding on negative credit notes (`applyTax(-X, r)` should equal `-applyTax(X, r)` with half-away-from-zero rounding on exact ties).
4. Formatting and parsing minor units must respect the currency's decimal places and never produce `"-0"` / `"-0.00"`.

Run `node --test test/public.test.ts` to check the visible tests, then inspect `src/` carefully for every edge case.
